pages.text: $(#5fa8e8)【Mastery】$()$(br2)Masters both melee and range: melee mobs also shoot arrows from 4 to 20 blocks away, and shooters also strike up close.$(br2)$(l)Accessory$(): Twinfold Insignia, which wards this affix off.
$(l)Dropped material$()$(br2)$(o)Two utterly different metals cast as one; it changes its shape to suit its surroundings.$()
